note: The splash of Veiddu's pond (engine/veiddu/veiddu-sounds.js). Two real recordings from Freesound, both CC0 1.0 (public domain): no credit is required, so there is no KREDIT.md. The owner chose both by ear from the candidates on 2026-10-31 ("1 og 2"). The files are the HQ previews Freesound serves without a login. Playback levels are set in code (veiddu-sounds.js SPLASHES), not baked in.

splash.mp3.title: Splash
splash.mp3.author: swordofkings128
splash.mp3.done: A hand splashed into pool water, 1.331 s, stereo 44.1 kHz. Cut from 0.02 s for 0.78 s (the attack is at 0.04 s, the tail and its small second splash end by 0.7 s), mixed to mono (half of each side), 3 ms fade-in, 80 ms fade-out, gain -0.2 dB so the peak is -1 dBFS (measured -0.9 after encoding), MP3 96 kbps mono 44.1 kHz with ffmpeg 9 / libmp3lame. Now 0.78 s.

splash-soft.mp3.use: Mosi's and Uggeðla's fishes and refills (played quieter than splash.mp3)
splash-soft.mp3.title: Water drop / Splash
splash-soft.mp3.author: bxyorna
splash-soft.mp3.done: A lighter plop, 1.084 s, mono 44.1 kHz, with a low room rumble under it. Cut from 0.46 s for 0.42 s (the plop is at 0.52 to 0.76 s: 50 ms of lead and 0.1 s of tail), 120 Hz high-pass, which takes about 18 dB off the rumble (a tablet's speaker does not play that low anyway), 3 ms fade-in, 80 ms fade-out, raised 24.3 dB so the peak is -1 dBFS (measured -1.0 after encoding), MP3 96 kbps mono 44.1 kHz with ffmpeg 9 / libmp3lame. Now 0.42 s.
